why: Slovak has no time adverb and no 'beautiful'/'winter'; only 'nový kabát v zľave'.
Slovak says only 'pes ... moju večeru zo stola'; no adjectives, adverb or kitchen.
No manner adverb, no quantifier and no location in 'vyhodila staré noviny do koša'.
Slovak gives no time phrase and no 'veľký'/'nový'; only 'trávnik pred naším domom'.
Only 'budúci týždeň opravia cestu pred školou'; manner, quantifier and 'new' invented.
'natrel plot na zeleno' carries no adverb and no 'whole'/'new'.
Slovak names only 'na chodník'; the school location is not in the source.
'pestuje paradajky' lists tomatoes only; peppers are added content.
'novú knihu o zvieratách' has no 'interesting', no 'wild' and no place.
